quotes.text: The people talk about how corrupt we, the Latter-day Saints, are. If all they say about us be true, it is only a tithing of what you will find in the world. I have told them to look at home ; to examine their own firesides, and they would find plenty of corruption and abomination. They are living without God in the world ; without hope ; and they are dying without hope ; consequently they are…
